name: Token Monitor
author: inocult
description: Tokens and dollars for every AI coding agent on the desk, as a wing dashboard and a bar readout.

barWidget.description: Today's spend and every subscription's limits. Click for the panel, middle-click for the wing.

schema.label: Show the dashboard
schema.description: The on/off switch at the bottom of the bar panel writes this.

schema.label: Dashboard form
schema.description: wing pins it to a screen and reserves its height; window makes it an ordinary tiled window.

schema.label: Default view
schema.description: Which pivot the panel opens on: machines and what each is signed into, or plans and where each is used.

schema.label: Wing monitor
schema.description: Connector the dashboard is pinned to, e.g. DVI-I-1. Empty picks the tallest portrait screen.

schema.label: Wing height (% of the screen, 0 = fit content)
schema.description: 0 sizes the dashboard to its own content and reserves exactly that, so the rest of the workspace tiles normally. 100 gives it the whole wing.
